title: Antarctic Sea Ice Fell To 1.79 Million Square Kilometers
hook: Antarctic sea ice fell to 1.79 million square kilometers.
closing: Less reflective ice leaves more heat in the ocean, affecting climate far beyond Antarctica.
question: Did you expect this much ice loss?

segments.say: Antarctic sea ice fell to 1.79 million square kilometers. That set the lowest February minimum in the data.
Antarctic ice was short by 1.3 million square kilometers. The missing area exceeds two major states combined.
Antarctic sea ice reflects 60 percent of sunlight. Losing it lets the darker ocean absorb far more heat.
